title: Archive Pull-In Semantics
prompt: Implement `int archive_pulls(size_t used_syms, size_t defined_syms, int member_needed)` modeling a linker decision: given an archive member defining `defined_syms` symbols of which the link currently needs `used_syms` (0 if none), and `member_needed` 1 iff the member defines a currently-undefined referenced symbol — return 1 iff the member gets pulled into the link. This models: pull-in happens exactly when the member resolves a pending undefined reference.

tests.name: needed member is pulled
tests.hint: The member defines a symbol the link needs: it is pulled in.

tests.name: unneeded member costs nothing
tests.hint: No pending reference matches: the member stays in the archive, adding zero bytes to the binary.
